prompt:
Image 1 is a close-up section of the Northern Song handscroll "Along the River During the Qingming Festival". Image 2 is the same area already repainted in our game's style at low resolution. Image 3 is the target art style.
Repaint image 1 in exactly image 3's style (hand-inked dark-brown linework, light hatching, muted painted colours, aged-silk palette), matching image 2's colours, lighting and how it interpreted each building, tree and figure, but at full detail. Muted palette taken from an aged Northern Song painting on silk: warm silk ochre, pale beige plaster, ink-brown timber, soft grey-blue clay roof tiles, undyed hemp white, faded indigo, dull vermilion and malachite-green accents, sage-green willow. Keep the colouring as muted and low in saturation as the art-style image: foliage is pale sage and grey-green, never bright green; the ground is warm silk-ochre packed earth; roofs are soft grey-blue clay tile. It is early spring at the Qingming festival: give every tree the species and leaf density painted in image 1, for example willows with sparse, fine, pale-green strands and trees that are still bare with dark ink-brown branches; never fill a tree into a dense green canopy. Clothing uses undyed hemp white, faded indigo, slate grey, ink-brown and dull vermilion, and every figure stands out clearly from the ground. Soft daylight with gentle cast shadows.
Image 1 is the ground truth for layout: keep its exact framing and its high oblique bird's-eye view, and keep every building, wall, stair, bridge, railing, tree, person, animal, cart and load in the same place, at the same size, facing the same way, in the same pose and in the same number. Do not add, remove, merge or move anything, do not shift or zoom the picture, and do not change the perspective or the crop: the edges show exactly what image 1's edges show, and things cut off there stay cut off.
Where the old silk is faded, dark or damaged, paint the detail it clearly shows: roof tile rows, brackets and timber joinery, rammed-earth walls, plank railings, trunks and branches, faces, clothing, loads, harnesses and wheels. The bare silk becomes packed-earth ground with sparse early grass. Remove the red collector's seals, silk cracks and stains. No text, no UI, no watermark.
